div.div: Each gateway calls Bedrock in the account and region it runs in, with its own role (hub role luminate-gateway-irsa; -us in us-east-1). No keys and no shared spoke account. The SCP permits only approved models, so a model that is registered but not approved fails at AWS.

div.div: The four accounts above are installs of the product, not where a business team promotes a workload. DEV · SIT · STAGE · PROD are rows inside the prod install: one control plane, one catalogue, one audit trail. Target: each environment's gateways run in that environment's account above, in ca-central-1 and us-east-1, and reach the prod control plane over an outbound TLS control link. Today all eight run in the prod account. Owned by the gateway-environment-strategy spec.

div.div: Serving regions are ca-central-1 and us-east-1, and the list is open. A region adds gateways in each environment's account — never another set of these installs, which stay in ca-central-1. Deploying the whole application per region is an anti-pattern: it forks the catalogue, the governance record and the audit trail.
